chars.OTHMAN: OTHMAN: an 18-year-old Moroccan boy with short curly black hair, wearing a bright red hoodie with white drawstrings, black joggers and white sneakers
chars.FATHER: FATHER: a Moroccan man in his fifties with a grey mustache, wearing a light blue polo shirt and beige trousers
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: a Moroccan woman in her late forties wearing a burgundy headscarf and a long cream cardigan
chars.STRANGER: STRANGER: a slim young man seen only from behind, black hair, wearing a black leather jacket and dark jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, warm cinematic lighting, modern hotel in Istanbul, Turkey. OTHMAN sits in an armchair in a hotel lobby, looking at his phone clock with an impatient face, a long corridor with room doors visible behind him in the distance.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, warm cinematic lighting, modern hotel in Istanbul, Turkey. Close-up of OTHMAN in the hotel lobby narrowing his eyes suspiciously, staring towards the corridor of rooms.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, warm cinematic lighting, modern hotel in Istanbul, Turkey. FATHER and MOTHER sit relaxed at a table in the hotel restaurant downstairs, eating and laughing, tea glasses on the table, big windows.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, warm cinematic lighting, modern hotel in Istanbul, Turkey. OTHMAN stands up from the lobby armchair, rubbing his head nervously, worried thoughtful expression.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, warm cinematic lighting, modern hotel in Istanbul, Turkey. STRANGER walks quickly into a long hotel corridor with carpet and numbered doors, seen from behind, heading towards a room door.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, warm cinematic lighting, modern hotel in Istanbul, Turkey. OTHMAN sneaks carefully into the hotel corridor, peeking around the corner, tense face.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, warm cinematic lighting, modern hotel in Istanbul, Turkey. OTHMAN stands frozen in the middle of the hotel corridor in shock, wide eyes, mouth open, staring at a closed room door.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, warm cinematic lighting, modern hotel in Istanbul, Turkey. OTHMAN tiptoes up to a closed hotel room door and leans his ear against it, holding his breath.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: 2D flat cartoon illustration, warm cinematic lighting, modern hotel in Istanbul, Turkey. Close-up of OTHMAN with his ear pressed against the hotel room door, face full of panic and anger, sweat on his forehead.
